bundle.shortDescription: Chat Computer: talk, type or touch, and it does the rest.
bundle.longDescription: Chat Computer, as you choose to have it: as an app (its screen in a window of its own, with its own model on this computer: free, with no account, and nothing sent anywhere; any site opens right in the middle; Messages from your own accounts; "/" finds your files), or as its own system next to Windows or macOS.
bundle.copyright: Chat Computer is an independent project.
